[SWS_CM_10289] Source of a SOME/IP event message
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_-
00042
⌈
The SOME/IP event message shall use the unicast
IP
address and port taken from
the IPv4/v6 Endpoint Option (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00307] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_
00315]) of the SOME/IP
OfferService
message ([SWS_CM_00203]) or the server
address which has been statically pre-configured by the static service connection ac-
cording to [SWS_CM_02201] as source address and source port for the transmission.
⌋
